# HAPI v0.30.7.4

## Compared with the previous maintained release

- Fix Codex archive returning an error after runner tracking loss even though the last shared-runtime root was already archived (upstream PR #1930).
- Refresh the existing session-control carry to PR #1771 head 5a0465f6: reserved Codex spawn-peer sessions bind their first native thread correctly; runner no-child evidence and stop confirmation are preserved.
- Retain the previous 24 carried PRs, desktop packaging, distribution guards, Android corrections and iOS test corrections. No additional feature removals relative to v0.30.7.3.
- Existing personal voice PR #1436 remains under its personal-PR policy exception; its reported draft-recovery and microphone-constraint limitations are unchanged.

## Compared with the official release

- Rebuilt from official main 86c88df93baf5d1f738dd4b202078bdf6dec376e (official release train v0.30.7), with 25 explicitly audited open PR carries.
- Includes the maintained session-control workflow, voice draft delivery, notification, composer, session-list and file-search fixes, plus PR #1930 archive confirmation.
- Retains signed macOS CLI artifacts, standalone Linux/Windows CLIs, desktop packages, four-part release gates and a replayable release manifest.
- The old fork-only features removed in v0.30.7.3 remain omitted. Closed unmerged PR #847 remains absent; PR #1320 is never replayed as a carry.

Complete per-PR decisions and personal policy exceptions: tools/maintenance/releases/v0.30.7.4/.
